'''Balba''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] who was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Minboosa District]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Vobbara Yusinduu]].<ref name="WhatBothersMinboosa" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.5}}</ref> Balba was freed by the [[Alliance Commander]] and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Sa'har Kateen]] during the [[rebellion in the Minboosa District]].<ref name="WhatBothersMinboosa" /> Balba asked the Commander to retrieve [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] from the [[Hidden Chain]] forces around the [[Shipping Facility]] in exchange for information about the Hidden Chain [[Hidden Chain dropship|shuttle]] in the district.<ref name="ToolingUpTheWorkers">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Tooling up the Workers|[[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]]}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Balba first appeared in the [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20240502-0|text=Game Update 7.5 "Desperate Defiance" Recap and VOD}}</ref>
